# Custom GUI Mod v1.2.3

## Added
- Configurable duplicate compensation for rune status 1 (Poison).
- Poison rune duplicates now grant Rune Dust, with a default value of 10 per duplicate.
- Duplicate compensation calculation modes: FIXED, BY_RANK and FORMULA.
- Event multipliers that modify the base compensation calculation without replacing it.
- Regression coverage for rune duplicate compensation configuration.

## Changed
- Duplicate compensation is now handled server-side and persisted through the resource system.
- Player rune-resource stats are refreshed immediately after purchases that produce duplicates.

## Validation
- Feature branch CI passed.
- Develop merge CI passed.
- Main merge CI passed.
- Manual in-game runtime validation passed.
